	["0"] = {" ### ","#   #","#  ##","# # #","##  #","#   #"," ### "},
	["1"] = {"  #  "," ##  ","  #  ","  #  ","  #  ","  #  "," ### "},

local function makeBox(name, y, placeholder, text)
	local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
	box.Name = name
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 36)
	box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, y)
	box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 58)
	box.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

	box.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
	box.Text = text
	box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	box.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	box.TextSize = 16
	box.Parent = frame
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	c.Parent = box
	return box
end

local textInput = makeBox("TextInput", 44, "Type text here...", "")
local sizeInput = makeBox("BlockSize", 88, "Block size (studs)", "1")

local function makeButton(name, x, y, w, text, color)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = name
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 36)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = color
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextSize = 16
	btn.AutoButtonColor = true
	btn.Parent = frame
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	c.Parent = btn
	return btn
end

local buildBtn = makeButton("BuildButton", 15, 136, 270, "BUILD TEXT", Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 80))
local undoBtn = makeButton("UndoButton", 15, 180, 130, "UNDO", Color3.fromRGB(180, 130, 0))
local clearBtn = makeButton("ClearButton", 155, 180, 130, "CLEAR ALL", Color3.fromRGB(170, 40, 40))

local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 20)
status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 220)
status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
status.Text = "Ready"
status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
status.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
status.TextSize = 13
status.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
status.Parent = frame

local function getRoot()
	local character = player.Character
	return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function buildText()
	local root = getRoot()
	if not root then
		status.Text = "No character found"
		return
	end

	local text = string.upper(textInput.Text)
	if #text == 0 then
		status.Text = "Enter some text first"
		return
	end

	local size = math.clamp(tonumber(sizeInput.Text) or 1, 0.2, 10)
	local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
	local origin = root.Position + look * 12 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
	local base = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + look)

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "TextBlocks_" .. text
	local blockCount = 0
	local totalCols = #text * 6 - 1
	local startX = -((totalCols - 1) / 2) * size

	for i = 1, #text do
		local ch = string.sub(text, i, i)
		local glyph = glyphs[ch]
		if glyph then
			local colOffset = (i - 1) * 6
			local hue = (i - 1) / math.max(#text, 1)
			local color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.6, 1)
			for row = 1, 7 do
				local line = glyph[row]
				for col = 1, 5 do
					if string.sub(line, col, col) == "#" then
						local x = startX + (colOffset + col - 1) * size
						local y = (7 - row) * size
						local part = Instance.new("Part")
						part.Size = Vector3.new(size, size, size)
						part.Anchored = true
						part.CanCollide = true
						part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
						part.Color = color
						part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
						part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
						part.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(x, y, 0)
						part.Parent = model
						blockCount += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if blockCount == 0 then
		model:Destroy()
		status.Text = "No supported characters (A-Z, 0-9)"
		return
	end

	model.Parent = workspace
	table.insert(builtModels, model)
	status.Text = "Built " .. blockCount .. " blocks"
end

buildBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(buildText)

undoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local last = table.remove(builtModels)
	if last then
		last:Destroy()
		status.Text = "Undid last build"
	else
		status.Text = "Nothing to undo"
	end
end)

clearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	for _, model in ipairs(builtModels) do
		model:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(builtModels)
	status.Text = "Cleared all text"
end)

        State.SavedCFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        
        local safePos = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, SAFE_ZONE_HEIGHT, 0)
        local platFolder, spawnCFrame = CreateSafePlatform(safePos)
        State.SafePlatform = platFolder
        
        char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(spawnCFrame)
        State.InSafeZone = true
        
        Settings.Enabled = false
        UpdateToggleVisual()
    end
end

local function ReturnFromSafeZone()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

    if State.InSafeZone and State.SavedCFrame then
        local targetCFrame = State.SavedCFrame
        local dist = Settings.OffsetDistance
        
        if Settings.OffsetDirection == "Вперед" then
            targetCFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -dist)
        elseif Settings.OffsetDirection == "Назад" then
            targetCFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, dist)
        elseif Settings.OffsetDirection == "Вправо" then
            targetCFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.new(dist, 0, 0)
        elseif Settings.OffsetDirection == "Влево" then
            targetCFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.new(-dist, 0, 0)
        end
        
        char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetCFrame
        
        if State.SafePlatform then
            State.SafePlatform:Destroy()
            State.SafePlatform = nil
        end
        State.InSafeZone = false
    end
end

local function IsFiniteVec(v)
	return v and v.X == v.X and v.Y == v.Y and v.Z == v.Z
		and math.abs(v.X) < 1e6 and math.abs(v.Y) < 1e6 and math.abs(v.Z) < 1e6
end

local function SafeUnit(v, fallback)
	if v and IsFiniteVec(v) and v.Magnitude > 0.001 then
		return v.Unit
	end
	return fallback or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
end

local function FlatUnit(v, fallback)
	if v and IsFiniteVec(v) then
		local flat = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			return flat.Unit
		end
	end
	return fallback or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
end

local function SafeLookAt(pos, lookDir, upVec)
	local up = SafeUnit(upVec or Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.yAxis)
	local dir = SafeUnit(lookDir, Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
	if math.abs(dir:Dot(up)) > 0.96 then
		dir = FlatUnit(lookDir, Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
		if math.abs(dir:Dot(up)) > 0.96 then
			dir = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
		end
	end
	local right = dir:Cross(up)
	if right.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		return CFrame.new(pos)
	end
	local rUnit = right.Unit
	local realUp = rUnit:Cross(dir).Unit
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(pos, rUnit, realUp, -dir)
end

			if self.Att0 then self.Att0:Destroy() end
			if self.Att1 then self.Att1:Destroy() end
		end,
	}
end

local function EnsureJoints()
	if not Character then return end
	local count = 0
	for _, m in pairs(Joints) do
		if m and m.Parent then count += 1 end
	end
	if count >= 5 then return end

	Joints = {}
	OrigC0 = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Motor6D") then
			Joints[d.Name] = d
			OrigC0[d.Name] = d.C0
		end
	end
end

local function RestoreJoints()
	for name, motor in pairs(Joints) do
		if motor and motor.Parent and OrigC0[name] then
			motor.C0 = OrigC0[name]
		end
	end
end

local function PoseJoint(name, offsetPos, rx, ry, rz, alpha)
	local motor = Joints[name]
	local base = OrigC0[name]
	if not motor or not motor.Parent or not base then return end
	local target = CFrame.new(base.Position + (offsetPos or Vector3.zero))
		* CFrame.Angles(rx or 0, ry or 0, rz or 0)
		* base.Rotation
	motor.C0 = motor.C0:Lerp(target, math.clamp(alpha or 0.25, 0, 1))
end

local function SetPose(pose, alpha)
	EnsureJoints()
	local a = alpha or 0.25
	if RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
		PoseJoint("RootJoint", pose.RootPos, pose.Root and pose.Root[1] or 0, pose.Root and pose.Root[2] or 0, pose.Root and pose.Root[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("Neck", nil, pose.Neck and pose.Neck[1] or 0, pose.Neck and pose.Neck[2] or 0, pose.Neck and pose.Neck[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("Right Shoulder", nil, pose.RS and pose.RS[1] or 0, pose.RS and pose.RS[2] or 0, pose.RS and pose.RS[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("Left Shoulder", nil, pose.LS and pose.LS[1] or 0, pose.LS and pose.LS[2] or 0, pose.LS and pose.LS[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("Right Hip", nil, pose.RH and pose.RH[1] or 0, pose.RH and pose.RH[2] or 0, pose.RH and pose.RH[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("Left Hip", nil, pose.LH and pose.LH[1] or 0, pose.LH and pose.LH[2] or 0, pose.LH and pose.LH[3] or 0, a)
	else
		PoseJoint("Root", pose.RootPos, pose.Root and pose.Root[1] or 0, pose.Root and pose.Root[2] or 0, pose.Root and pose.Root[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("Waist", nil, pose.Waist and pose.Waist[1] or 0, pose.Waist and pose.Waist[2] or 0, pose.Waist and pose.Waist[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("Neck", nil, pose.Neck and pose.Neck[1] or 0, pose.Neck and pose.Neck[2] or 0, pose.Neck and pose.Neck[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("RightShoulder", nil, pose.RS and pose.RS[1] or 0, pose.RS and pose.RS[2] or 0, pose.RS and pose.RS[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("RightElbow", nil, pose.RE and pose.RE[1] or 0, pose.RE and pose.RE[2] or 0, pose.RE and pose.RE[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("LeftShoulder", nil, pose.LS and pose.LS[1] or 0, pose.LS and pose.LS[2] or 0, pose.LS and pose.LS[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("LeftElbow", nil, pose.LE and pose.LE[1] or 0, pose.LE and pose.LE[2] or 0, pose.LE and pose.LE[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("RightHip", nil, pose.RH and pose.RH[1] or 0, pose.RH and pose.RH[2] or 0, pose.RH and pose.RH[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("RightKnee", nil, pose.RK and pose.RK[1] or 0, pose.RK and pose.RK[2] or 0, pose.RK and pose.RK[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("LeftHip", nil, pose.LH and pose.LH[1] or 0, pose.LH and pose.LH[2] or 0, pose.LH and pose.LH[3] or 0, a)
		PoseJoint("LeftKnee", nil, pose.LK and pose.LK[1] or 0, pose.LK and pose.LK[2] or 0, pose.LK and pose.LK[3] or 0, a)
	end
end

	Root.Anchored = false

local function ReleaseSwing(boost)
	if not State.Swinging then return end
	State.Swinging = false
	PlaySFX(SOUNDS.WebSnap, 0.8, 1.08)

	local curVel = (Root and IsFiniteVec(Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)) and Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or State.SwingVel
	if not IsFiniteVec(curVel) then curVel = Vector3.zero end

	CleanupSwingVisuals()
	RestoreFreeControl()

	if Root then
		local camLook = Camera and Camera.CFrame.LookVector or Root.CFrame.LookVector
		local flatLook = FlatUnit(camLook, FlatUnit(Root.CFrame.LookVector))
		local horiz = Vector3.new(curVel.X, 0, curVel.Z)
		local dir = (Humanoid and Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05)
			and FlatUnit(Humanoid.MoveDirection, flatLook)
			or (horiz.Magnitude > 6 and horiz.Unit or flatLook)

		Root.CFrame = SafeLookAt(Root.Position, dir, Vector3.yAxis)
		Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

		if boost then
			PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Whoosh, 0.92, 1.14)
			local releaseSpeed = math.clamp(math.max(horiz.Magnitude * 1.14, 68), 64, 132)
			local releaseUp = math.clamp(curVel.Y * 0.45 + 48, 40, 72)
			Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * releaseSpeed + Vector3.new(0, releaseUp, 0)
			TriggerAction("Backflip", 0.56)
		else
			Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = horiz + Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(curVel.Y, -75, 55), 0)
		end
	end

	SetButtonActive("SWING", false)
end

local function AttachNewSwingWeb(anchorPos)
	CleanupSwingVisuals()

	State.SwingAnchorPos = anchorPos
	State.SwingAge = 0
	State.SwingHand = (State.SwingHand == "Right") and "Left" or "Right"

	local dist = (anchorPos - Root.Position).Magnitude
	State.SwingRopeLen = math.clamp(dist * 0.94, 26, 86)

	local anchorPart = CreateAnchorAt(anchorPos)
	State.SwingAnchorPart = anchorPart

	local hand = GetHandPart(State.SwingHand)
	local attHand = Instance.new("Attachment", hand)
	local attAnchor = Instance.new("Attachment", anchorPart)
	State.SwingWeb = CreateRealisticWeb(attHand, attAnchor)

	PlaySFX(SOUNDS.WebShoot, 0.92, 0.98 + math.random() * 0.08)
	SparkVFX(hand.Position, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 10, 0.3)
	SparkVFX(anchorPos, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 16, 0.48)
end

local function StartSwing()
	if not Root or not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	if State.Swinging then return end
	StopCrawling()
	StopWings()
	StopCombatMove()
	StopWebFling()

	local camLook = Camera and Camera.CFrame.LookVector or Root.CFrame.LookVector
	local flatLook = FlatUnit(camLook, FlatUnit(Root.CFrame.LookVector))

	local vel = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	if not IsFiniteVec(vel) then vel = Vector3.zero end
	local hSpeed = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude

	local forwardDist = math.clamp(48 + hSpeed * 0.35, 46, 84)
	local upHeight = math.clamp(56 + math.max(0, camLook.Y * 22), 50, 78)
	local anchorPos = Root.Position + flatLook * forwardDist + Vector3.new(0, upHeight, 0)

	State.Swinging = true
	State.SwingBank = 0
	State.SwingVel = vel

	Root.Anchored = false
	Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	Humanoid.Sit = false
	Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	pcall(function()
		Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
	end)
	RestoreJoints()

	if Animator then
		for _, tr in ipairs(Animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
			if tr ~= SwingTrack then
				pcall(function() tr:Stop(0.1) end)
			end
		end
	end
	if SwingTrack then
		pcall(function()
			SwingTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
			SwingTrack:Play(0.12, 1, 1)
		end)
	end

	AttachNewSwingWeb(anchorPos)

	if vel.Y < -10 then
		local catchSpeed = math.clamp(hSpeed + math.abs(vel.Y) * 0.55, 52, 118)
		Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = flatLook * catchSpeed + Vector3.new(0, vel.Y * 0.3, 0)
	elseif hSpeed < 36 then
		Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = flatLook * 48 + Vector3.new(0, math.max(vel.Y, -6), 0)
	end

	SetButtonActive("SWING", true)
end

local function FindBestTarget(maxDist, minDot)
	if not Root then return nil, nil end
	local bestRoot, bestHum, bestScore = nil, nil, maxDist or 30
	local camPos = Camera and Camera.CFrame.Position or Root.Position
	local camLook = Camera and Camera.CFrame.LookVector or Root.CFrame.LookVector
	local reqDot = minDot or 0.2

	for _, model in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if model ~= Character and model:IsA("Model") then
			local h = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local r = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
			if h and r and h.Health > 0 then
				local toTarget = r.Position - Root.Position
				local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
				if dist < bestScore and dist > 0.1 then
					local camDir = SafeUnit(r.Position - camPos, camLook)
					local dot = camDir:Dot(camLook)
					if dot >= reqDot or dist < 10 then
						local score = dist * (1.35 - math.clamp(dot, 0, 1) * 0.5)
						if score < bestScore then
							bestScore = score
							bestRoot = r
							bestHum = h
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestRoot, bestHum
end

local function FlingEnemyModel(eRoot, eHum, dir, power, upPower)
	if not eRoot then return end
	local launchDir = SafeUnit(dir, FlatUnit(Root and Root.CFrame.LookVector))
	if eHum then
		eHum.PlatformStand = true
		eHum.Sit = true
		pcall(function()
			eHum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)
		end)
		task.delay(2.2, function()
			if eHum and eHum.Parent then
				eHum.PlatformStand = false
				eHum.Sit = false
			end
		end)
	end
	eRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = launchDir * power + Vector3.new(0, upPower or (power * 0.55), 0)
	eRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(38, 65, 38)
end

local function StartTargetWebFling(targetRoot, targetHum, flingDir)
	if not Root or not targetRoot then return end
	FlingEnemyModel(targetRoot, targetHum, flingDir, 240, 120)

	State.WebFlingSavedCF = Root.CFrame
	State.WebFlingSavedVel = IsFiniteVec(Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity) and Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
	State.WebFlingTarget = targetRoot
	State.WebFlingDir = SafeUnit(flingDir, FlatUnit(Root.CFrame.LookVector))
	State.WebFlingEnd = os.clock() + 0.16
	State.WebFlingActive = true
end

local function ShootWeb()
	if not Root or not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	PlaySFX(SOUNDS.WebShoot, 0.95, 1.12)
	TriggerAction("ShootWeb", 0.34)

	local camLook = SafeUnit(Camera.CFrame.LookVector, Root.CFrame.LookVector)
	local targetRoot, targetHum = FindBestTarget(135, 0.65)

	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character }
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local rayRes = Workspace:Raycast(Camera.CFrame.Position, camLook * 160, rp)

	if not targetRoot and rayRes and rayRes.Instance then
		local model = rayRes.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local h = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local r = model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
		if h and r and model ~= Character then
			targetRoot = r
			targetHum = h
		end
	end

	local hand = GetHandPart("Right")
	local att0 = Instance.new("Attachment", hand)

	if targetRoot then
		local att1 = Instance.new("Attachment", targetRoot)
		local web = CreateRealisticWeb(att0, att1)
		SparkVFX(targetRoot.Position, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 22, 0.55)
		PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Hit, 1.0, 1.0, targetRoot)
		PlaySFX(SOUNDS.KO, 0.95, 1.02, targetRoot)
		State.CamShake = math.max(State.CamShake, 0.55)

		local flingDir = FlatUnit(targetRoot.Position - Root.Position, FlatUnit(camLook))
		StartTargetWebFling(targetRoot, targetHum, flingDir)

		task.delay(0.32, function()
			web:Destroy()
		end)
	else
		local hitPos = rayRes and rayRes.Position or (Camera.CFrame.Position + camLook * 135)
		local anchor = CreateAnchorAt(hitPos)
		local att1 = Instance.new("Attachment", anchor)
		local web = CreateRealisticWeb(att0, att1)
		SparkVFX(hitPos, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 16, 0.45)

		if rayRes and rayRes.Instance and not rayRes.Instance.Anchored then
			PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Hit, 0.9, 1.05, rayRes.Instance)
			rayRes.Instance.AssemblyLinearVelocity = camLook * 165 + Vector3.new(0, 65, 0)
			rayRes.Instance.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(30, 50, 30)
		end

		task.delay(0.28, function()
			web:Destroy()
			anchor:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end

local function StartCombatMove(actionName, duration, lungeSpeed, upBoost, knockPower)
	if not Root or not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	if State.Swinging then ReleaseSwing(false) end
	StopCrawling()
	StopWings()
	StopCombatMove()

	local maxRange = (actionName == "SwingKick") and 44 or 20
	local targetRoot = FindBestTarget(maxRange, 0.15)
	local dir
	if targetRoot then
		dir = FlatUnit(targetRoot.Position - Root.Position, FlatUnit(Root.CFrame.LookVector))
	else
		dir = FlatUnit(Camera.CFrame.LookVector, FlatUnit(Root.CFrame.LookVector))
	end

	RestoreFreeControl()
	Root.CFrame = SafeLookAt(Root.Position, dir, Vector3.yAxis)
	Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * lungeSpeed + Vector3.new(0, upBoost, 0)

	State.CombatActive = true
	State.CombatEnd = os.clock() + duration
	State.CombatDir = dir
	State.CombatSpeed = lungeSpeed
	State.CombatUp = upBoost
	State.CombatPower = knockPower
	State.HitTargets = {}

	TriggerAction(actionName, duration)
end

	State.LastCombatTime = now

	State.PunchCombo = (combo % 3) + 1

	PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Whoosh, 0.88, 0.96 + combo * 0.07)
	StartCombatMove("Punch" .. combo, 0.36, 36 + combo * 5, (combo == 3) and 18 or 4, 155 + combo * 25)

local function DropGrabbed(throwIt)
	if not State.GrabbedPart then return end
	local part = State.GrabbedPart
	State.GrabbedPart = nil

	if State.GrabPos then State.GrabPos:Destroy(); State.GrabPos = nil end
	if State.GrabGyro then State.GrabGyro:Destroy(); State.GrabGyro = nil end
	if State.GrabAttach then State.GrabAttach:Destroy(); State.GrabAttach = nil end
	if State.GrabWebL then State.GrabWebL:Destroy(); State.GrabWebL = nil end
	if State.GrabWebR then State.GrabWebR:Destroy(); State.GrabWebR = nil end

	for _, nc in ipairs(State.NoColls) do
		if nc then nc:Destroy() end
	end
	State.NoColls = {}
	SetButtonActive("GRAB", false)

	if part and part.Parent then
		part.Massless = false
		if throwIt and Root then
			PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Heavy, 1.0, 0.92)
			TriggerAction("Throw", 0.42)
			local look = SafeUnit(Camera.CFrame.LookVector, Root.CFrame.LookVector)
			part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = look * 165 + Vector3.new(0, 36, 0)
			SparkVFX(part.Position, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 18, 0.5)
		end
	end
end

local function ToggleGrab()
	if State.GrabbedPart then
		DropGrabbed(false)
		return
	end
	if not Root then return end

	local best, bestDist = nil, 28
	for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v.Anchored and not v:IsDescendantOf(Character) then
			local hum = v.Parent and v.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not hum then
				local d = (v.Position - Root.Position).Magnitude
				if d < bestDist then
					best = v
					bestDist = d
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if not best then return end

	PlaySFX(SOUNDS.WebShoot, 0.85, 0.96)
	State.GrabbedPart = best
	best.Massless = true

	for _, limb in ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
		if limb:IsA("BasePart") then
			local nc = Instance.new("NoCollisionConstraint")
			nc.Part0 = limb
			nc.Part1 = best
			nc.Parent = best
			table.insert(State.NoColls, nc)
		end
	end

	local att = Instance.new("Attachment", best)
	State.GrabAttach = att

	local ap = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
	ap.Attachment0 = att
	ap.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	ap.MaxForce = 9e6
	ap.MaxVelocity = 95
	ap.Responsiveness = 30
	ap.Position = Root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0)
	ap.Parent = best
	State.GrabPos = ap

	local ao = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	ao.Attachment0 = att
	ao.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	ao.MaxTorque = 9e6
	ao.Responsiveness = 25
	ao.CFrame = Root.CFrame
	ao.Parent = best
	State.GrabGyro = ao

	State.GrabWebL = CreateRealisticWeb(Instance.new("Attachment", GetHandPart("Left")), att)
	State.GrabWebR = CreateRealisticWeb(Instance.new("Attachment", GetHandPart("Right")), att)
	SetButtonActive("GRAB", true)
end

local function ToggleWings()

		StopWings()
		return
	end
	if not Root or not Humanoid then return end
	if State.Swinging then ReleaseSwing(false) end
	StopCrawling()
	StopCombatMove()

	State.Gliding = true
	Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Whoosh, 0.9, 0.9)

	if not State.WingL or not State.WingL.Parent then
		local torso = Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or Root
		local armL = Character:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerArm") or Character:FindFirstChild("Left Arm") or GetHandPart("Left")
		local armR = Character:FindFirstChild("RightLowerArm") or Character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or GetHandPart("Right")

		local function makeWing(side, arm)
			local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment", torso)
			a0.Position = Vector3.new(side * 0.9, -0.35, 0)
			local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment", arm)
			a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.25, 0)
			local b = Instance.new("Beam")
			b.Attachment0 = a0
			b.Attachment1 = a1
			b.FaceCamera = false
			b.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(235, 245, 255))
			b.LightEmission = 0.35
			b.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.12),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.42),
			})
			b.Width0 = 0
			b.Width1 = 0
			b.CurveSize0 = -0.6
			b.Segments = 18
			b.Parent = torso
			return b
		end
		State.WingL = makeWing(-1, armL)
		State.WingR = makeWing(1, armR)
	end

	TweenService:Create(State.WingL, TweenInfo.new(0.22), { Width0 = 2.4, Width1 = 1.4 }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(State.WingR, TweenInfo.new(0.22), { Width0 = 2.4, Width1 = 1.4 }):Play()

	SetButtonActive("WINGS", true)
end

local function ToggleCrawl()
	if State.Crawling then
		StopCrawling()
		return
	end
	if not Root or not Humanoid then return end

	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character }
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	local dirs = {
		Root.CFrame.LookVector,
		-Root.CFrame.LookVector,
		Root.CFrame.RightVector,
		-Root.CFrame.RightVector,
		Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
	}
	local hit = nil
	for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
		local r = Workspace:Raycast(Root.Position, d * 8, rp)
		if r then hit = r; break end
	end
	if not hit then return end

	if State.Swinging then ReleaseSwing(false) end
	StopWings()
	StopCombatMove()

	State.Crawling = true
	State.WallNormal = SafeUnit(hit.Normal, Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
	State.WallPos = hit.Position + State.WallNormal * 2.1
	Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	SetButtonActive("CRAWL", true)
end

local function DoDodge(evadeDir)
	if not Root or not Humanoid then return end
	if State.Swinging then ReleaseSwing(false) end
	StopCrawling()
	StopWings()
	PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Whoosh, 0.9, 1.2)

	local dir = evadeDir
	if not dir or dir.Magnitude < 0.05 then
		dir = Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1
			and SafeUnit(Humanoid.MoveDirection)
			or -FlatUnit(Root.CFrame.LookVector)
	end
	dir = SafeUnit(dir, -FlatUnit(Root.CFrame.LookVector))
	RestoreFreeControl()
	Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * 82 + Vector3.new(0, 20, 0)
	TriggerAction("Dodge", 0.36)
	SparkVFX(Root.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70), 12, 0.35)
end

local function DoBackflip()
	if not Root or not Humanoid then return end
	if State.Swinging then
		ReleaseSwing(true)
		return
	end
	StopCrawling()
	StopWings()
	PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Whoosh, 0.9, 1.15)
	RestoreFreeControl()
	Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = -FlatUnit(Root.CFrame.LookVector) * 44 + Vector3.new(0, 62, 0)
	TriggerAction("Backflip", 0.56)
end

local function StartJumpCharge()
	if State.Crawling then
		local n = SafeUnit(State.WallNormal, Vector3.yAxis)
		StopCrawling()
		PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Whoosh, 0.9, 1.1)
		Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (n * 56) + Vector3.new(0, 64, 0)
		TriggerAction("Backflip", 0.52)
		return
	end
	if State.Swinging then
		ReleaseSwing(true)
		return
	end
	State.ChargingJump = true
	State.JumpStart = os.clock()
	State.JumpCharge = 0
	if JumpBarBg then JumpBarBg.Visible = true end
	SetButtonActive("JUMP", true)
end

local function ReleaseJumpCharge()
	if not State.ChargingJump then return end
	State.ChargingJump = false
	if JumpBarBg then JumpBarBg.Visible = false end
	SetButtonActive("JUMP", false)
	if not Root then return end

	local pwr = 58 + State.JumpCharge * 88
	PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Whoosh, 0.95, 0.95)
	SparkVFX(Root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 16, 0.5)
	RestoreFreeControl()
	Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = FlatUnit(Root.CFrame.LookVector) * (24 + State.JumpCharge * 38) + Vector3.new(0, pwr, 0)
	TriggerAction("Backflip", 0.54)
	State.JumpCharge = 0
end

local function ToggleSprint()
	State.Sprinting = not State.Sprinting
	SetButtonActive("SPRINT", State.Sprinting)
end

local function ToggleSense()
	State.SenseEnabled = not State.SenseEnabled
	SetButtonActive("SENSE", State.SenseEnabled)
	if Buttons.SENSE then
		Buttons.SENSE.Text = State.SenseEnabled and "SENSE: ON" or "SENSE: OFF"
	end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, gp)
	if gp then return end
	local k = inp.KeyCode
	if k == Enum.KeyCode.E or k == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2 then StartSwing()
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Z or k == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 then DoPunch()
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.T or k == Enum.KeyCode.K or k == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 then
		if State.Swinging then DoWebSwingKick() else DoKick() end
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.J then DoWebSwingKick()
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.F or k == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX then ShootWeb()
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Q or k == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2 then WebZip()
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.C or k == Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp then ToggleCrawl()
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.X or k == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB then DoDodge()
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.B or k == Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown then DoBackflip()
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.G or k == Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft then ToggleGrab()
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.H or k == Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight then DropGrabbed(true)
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.V or k == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY then ToggleWings()
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.P then ToggleSense()
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then StartJumpCharge()
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or k == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL3 then ToggleSprint()
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp, gp)
	if ActiveTouches[inp] then
		local cb = ActiveTouches[inp]
		ActiveTouches[inp] = nil
		cb()
	end
	if gp then return end
	local k = inp.KeyCode
	if k == Enum.KeyCode.E or k == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2 then ReleaseSwing(true)
	elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then ReleaseJumpCharge()
	end
end)

local function StepProceduralAnimation(dt)
	if not Character or not Humanoid or not Root then return end
	EnsureJoints()

	if State.Swinging then
		RestoreJoints()
		return
	end

	for _, motor in pairs(Joints) do
		if motor and motor.Parent then
			motor.Transform = CFrame.new()
		end
	end

	State.AnimTime += dt
	local now = os.clock()
	local vel = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	if not IsFiniteVec(vel) then vel = Vector3.zero end
	local hSpeed = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
	local inAir = (Humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air)

	if inAir then
		State.LastAirVelY = vel.Y
	elseif State.WasInAir then
		if State.LastAirVelY < -28 then
			State.LandTime = now + 0.28
			State.CamShake = math.max(State.CamShake, math.clamp(math.abs(State.LastAirVelY) / 110, 0.22, 0.7))
			PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Land, 0.75, 1.15)
			SparkVFX(Root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0), Color3.fromRGB(230, 235, 245), 14, 0.42)
		end
		State.LastAirVelY = 0
	end
	State.WasInAir = inAir

	if State.Action and (now - State.ActionStart) < State.ActionDur then
		local prog = math.clamp((now - State.ActionStart) / State.ActionDur, 0, 1)
		local act = State.Action
		if act == "Punch1" then
			SetPose({ Root = { -0.18, -0.68, 0 }, Waist = { 0, -0.35, 0 }, RS = { 1.58, 0, 0.2 }, RE = { 0.1, 0, 0 }, LS = { 0.9, 0.4, -0.4 }, LE = { 1.1, 0, 0 }, RH = { -0.35, 0, 0 }, LH = { 0.35, 0, 0 } }, 0.42)
		elseif act == "Punch2" then
			SetPose({ Root = { -0.18, 0.68, 0 }, Waist = { 0, 0.35, 0 }, LS = { 1.58, 0, -0.2 }, LE = { 0.1, 0, 0 }, RS = { 0.9, -0.4, 0.4 }, RE = { 1.1, 0, 0 }, RH = { 0.35, 0, 0 }, LH = { -0.35, 0, 0 } }, 0.42)
		elseif act == "Punch3" then
			SetPose({ Root = { 0.25, -0.45, 0 }, Waist = { 0.2, -0.25, 0 }, RS = { 2.55, 0, 0.15 }, RE = { 0.35, 0, 0 }, LS = { -0.6, 0, -0.4 }, RH = { 0.45, 0, 0 }, RK = { -0.6, 0, 0 }, LH = { -0.45, 0, 0 } }, 0.42)
		elseif act == "Kick1" then
			SetPose({ Root = { 0.28, 0.65, 0.25 }, RS = { 0.8, 0, 0.7 }, LS = { 0.8, 0, -0.7 }, RH = { 1.68, 0, 0.35 }, RK = { 0, 0, 0 }, LH = { -0.45, 0, -0.15 }, LK = { -0.35, 0, 0 } }, 0.42)
		elseif act == "Kick2" then
			local spin = prog * math.pi * 2
			SetPose({ Root = { 0.22, spin, -0.2 }, RS = { 1.1, 0, 0.8 }, LS = { 1.1, 0, -0.8 }, LH = { 1.68, 0, -0.3 }, LK = { 0, 0, 0 }, RH = { -0.4, 0, 0 } }, 0.48)
		elseif act == "Kick3" then
			SetPose({ Root = { 0.5, 0, 0 }, RS = { -0.7, 0, 0.6 }, LS = { -0.7, 0, -0.6 }, RH = { 1.75, 0, 0.12 }, LH = { 1.55, 0, -0.12 }, RK = { 0, 0, 0 }, LK = { 0, 0, 0 } }, 0.42)
		elseif act == "SwingKick" then
			SetPose({ Root = { 0.88, 0, 0 }, Waist = { 0.15, 0, 0 }, Neck = { -0.45, 0, 0 }, RS = { 2.2, 0, 0.25 }, LS = { -0.75, 0, -0.6 }, RH = { 1.65, 0, 0.12 }, RK = { 0, 0, 0 }, LH = { 1.52, 0, -0.12 }, LK = { -0.1, 0, 0 } }, 0.42)
		elseif act == "ShootWeb" then
			SetPose({ Root = { -0.15, -0.32, 0 }, RS = { 1.62, 0, 0.1 }, RE = { 0.12, 0, 0 }, LS = { -0.4, 0, -0.3 }, RH = { 0.25, 0, 0 }, LH = { -0.25, 0, 0 } }, 0.42)
		elseif act == "WebZip" then
			SetPose({ Root = { -0.95, 0, 0 }, Neck = { 0.55, 0, 0 }, RS = { -0.9, 0, 0.45 }, LS = { -0.9, 0, -0.45 }, RH = { -0.6, 0, 0 }, RK = { -0.8, 0, 0 }, LH = { -0.6, 0, 0 }, LK = { -0.8, 0, 0 } }, 0.38)
		elseif act == "Throw" then
			SetPose({ Root = { -0.5, 0, 0 }, RS = { 1.75, 0, 0.25 }, LS = { 1.75, 0, -0.25 }, RH = { -0.4, 0, 0 }, LH = { 0.4, 0, 0 } }, 0.38)
		elseif act == "Dodge" then
			SetPose({ RootPos = Vector3.new(0, -0.7, 0), Root = { -0.55, 0, 0.45 }, RS = { -0.6, 0, 0.8 }, LS = { -0.6, 0, -0.8 }, RH = { 0.9, 0, 0 }, RK = { -1.1, 0, 0 }, LH = { 0.9, 0, 0 }, LK = { -1.1, 0, 0 } }, 0.38)
		elseif act == "Backflip" then
			local pitch = prog * math.pi * 2
			SetPose({ Root = { pitch, 0, 0 }, RS = { 0.9, 0, 0.6 }, LS = { 0.9, 0, -0.6 }, RH = { 1.2, 0, 0.15 }, RK = { -1.35, 0, 0 }, LH = { 1.2, 0, -0.15 }, LK = { -1.35, 0, 0 } }, 0.55)
		end
		return
	end

	if State.Gliding then
		SetPose({ Root = { 0, 0, -State.BankAngle * 0.4 }, Neck = { 0.65, 0, 0 }, RS = { 0.15, 0, 1.48 }, RE = { 0, 0, 0 }, LS = { 0.15, 0, -1.48 }, LE = { 0, 0, 0 }, RH = { -0.2, 0, 0.28 }, LH = { -0.2, 0, -0.28 } }, 0.25)
	elseif State.Crawling then
		local cr = (hSpeed > 1 or math.abs(vel.Y) > 1) and math.sin(State.AnimTime * 11) * 0.55 or 0
		SetPose({ RootPos = Vector3.new(0, -0.65, 0), Root = { -0.25, 0, cr * 0.18 }, Neck = { 0.55, 0, 0 }, RS = { 1.25 + cr, 0, 0.95 }, RE = { 0.8, 0, 0 }, LS = { 1.25 - cr, 0, -0.95 }, LE = { 0.8, 0, 0 }, RH = { 1.0 - cr, 0, 0.85 }, RK = { -1.05, 0, 0 }, LH = { 1.0 + cr, 0, -0.85 }, LK = { -1.05, 0, 0 } }, 0.28)
	elseif State.GrabbedPart then
		local sw = math.sin(State.AnimTime * 9) * (hSpeed > 2 and 0.55 or 0)
		SetPose({ Root = { 0.15, 0, 0 }, RS = { 2.85, 0, 0.3 }, RE = { 0.25, 0, 0 }, LS = { 2.85, 0, -0.3 }, LE = { 0.25, 0, 0 }, RH = { sw, 0, 0 }, RK = { -math.max(0, sw), 0, 0 }, LH = { -sw, 0, 0 }, LK = { -math.max(0, -sw), 0, 0 } }, 0.25)
	elseif State.ChargingJump then
		local c = State.JumpCharge
		SetPose({ RootPos = Vector3.new(0, -1.15 * c, 0), Root = { -0.75 * c, 0, 0 }, Neck = { 0.55 * c, 0, 0 }, RS = { -0.65 * c, 0, 0.45 }, LS = { -0.65 * c, 0, -0.45 }, RH = { 1.15 * c, 0, 0.3 }, RK = { -1.35 * c, 0, 0 }, LH = { 1.15 * c, 0, -0.3 }, LK = { -1.35 * c, 0, 0 } }, 0.3)
	elseif now < State.LandTime then
		SetPose({ RootPos = Vector3.new(0, -1.15, 0), Root = { -0.72, 0, 0 }, Neck = { 0.52, 0, 0 }, RS = { 0.88, 0, 0.45 }, LS = { -0.65, 0, -0.55 }, RH = { 1.18, 0, 0.35 }, RK = { -1.38, 0, 0 }, LH = { 1.18, 0, -0.35 }, LK = { -1.38, 0, 0 } }, 0.38)
	elseif inAir then
		local flutter = math.sin(State.AnimTime * 15) * 0.08
		if vel.Y > 8 then
			SetPose({ Root = { -0.22, 0, 0 }, Neck = { 0.28, 0, 0 }, RS = { 1.85 + flutter, 0, 0.45 }, RE = { 0.5, 0, 0 }, LS = { 1.85 - flutter, 0, -0.45 }, LE = { 0.5, 0, 0 }, RH = { 1.05, 0, 0.2 }, RK = { -1.25, 0, 0 }, LH = { 0.45, 0, -0.2 }, LK = { -0.8, 0, 0 } }, 0.24)
		elseif vel.Y > -22 then
			SetPose({ Root = { -0.38, 0, 0 }, Neck = { 0.35, 0, 0 }, RS = { 0.35 + flutter, 0, 0.85 }, RE = { 0.55, 0, 0 }, LS = { 0.35 - flutter, 0, -0.85 }, LE = { 0.55, 0, 0 }, RH = { 0.95, 0, 0.28 }, RK = { -1.15, 0, 0 }, LH = { 0.75, 0, -0.28 }, LK = { -0.95, 0, 0 } }, 0.22)
		else
			SetPose({ Root = { -0.85, 0, flutter * 0.5 }, Neck = { 0.62, 0, 0 }, RS = { -0.45 + flutter, 0, 1.15 }, RE = { 0.35, 0, 0 }, LS = { -0.45 - flutter, 0, -1.15 }, LE = { 0.35, 0, 0 }, RH = { 0.55 + flutter, 0, 0.35 }, RK = { -0.85, 0, 0 }, LH = { 0.55 - flutter, 0, -0.35 }, LK = { -0.85, 0, 0 } }, 0.22)
		end
	elseif hSpeed > 1.5 then
		local runFreq = State.Sprinting and 14 or 10
		local amp = math.clamp(hSpeed / 22, 0.35, 1.15)
		local s = math.sin(State.AnimTime * runFreq) * amp
		local c = math.cos(State.AnimTime * runFreq) * amp
		local lean = State.Sprinting and -0.45 or -0.18
		SetPose({
			RootPos = Vector3.new(0, math.abs(c) * 0.22 - 0.12, 0),
			Root = { lean, -s * 0.16, 0 },
			Waist = { 0, -s * 0.14, 0 },
			Neck = { -lean * 0.65, s * 0.1, 0 },
			RS = { -s * 0.95, 0, 0.18 },
			RE = { 0.65 + math.max(0, -s) * 0.5, 0, 0 },
			LS = { s * 0.95, 0, -0.18 },
			LE = { 0.65 + math.max(0, s) * 0.5, 0, 0 },
			RH = { s * 0.95, 0, 0.05 },
			RK = { -math.max(0, -s) * 1.15 - 0.15, 0, 0 },
			LH = { -s * 0.95, 0, -0.05 },
			LK = { -math.max(0, s) * 1.15 - 0.15, 0, 0 },
		}, 0.3)
	else
		local br = math.sin(State.AnimTime * 2.6) * 0.06
		local crouch = State.ThreatActive and -0.45 or -0.12
		SetPose({
			RootPos = Vector3.new(0, crouch + br, 0),
			Root = { State.ThreatActive and -0.35 or -0.08, 0.15, 0 },
			Neck = { 0.08, -0.15, 0 },
			RS = { 0.22 + br, 0, 0.28 },
			RE = { 0.55, 0, 0 },
			LS = { 0.22 - br, 0, -0.28 },
			LE = { 0.55, 0, 0 },
			RH = { 0.22, 0, 0.16 },
			RK = { -0.35, 0, 0 },
			LH = { 0.22, 0, -0.16 },
			LK = { -0.35, 0, 0 },
		}, 0.2)
	end
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if not HUDGui or not HUDGui.Parent then
		BuildHUD()
	end
	if not Character or not Root or not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

	if State.WebFlingActive and State.WebFlingSavedCF then
		Root.CFrame = State.WebFlingSavedCF
		Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end

	if State.CombatActive then
		if os.clock() >= State.CombatEnd then
			StopCombatMove()
		else
			local curVel = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local forwardSpeed = State.CombatSpeed * 0.85
			Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = State.CombatDir * forwardSpeed + Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(curVel.Y, -35, 45), 0)

			if State.SKWeb then
				State.SKWeb:Update(os.clock() - State.ActionStart, 1.0)
			end

			local hitCenter = Root.Position + State.CombatDir * 4.5
			local parts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(hitCenter), Vector3.new(8.5, 7.5, 8.5))
			for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
				if not part:IsDescendantOf(Character) then
					local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
					local hum = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					local eRoot = model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
					if hum and eRoot and hum.Health > 0 and not State.HitTargets[model] then
						State.HitTargets[model] = true
						State.CamShake = math.max(State.CamShake, 0.75)
						PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Hit, 1.0, 0.96, eRoot)
						PlaySFX(SOUNDS.KO, 0.95, 1.0, eRoot)
						SparkVFX(eRoot.Position, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 75), 22, 0.65)
						StartTargetWebFling(eRoot, hum, State.CombatDir)
					elseif not part.Anchored and not hum and not State.HitTargets[part] then
						State.HitTargets[part] = true
						PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Hit, 0.85, 1.02, part)
						part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = State.CombatDir * State.CombatPower + Vector3.new(0, 52, 0)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local vel = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	if not IsFiniteVec(vel) then
		vel = Vector3.zero
		Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
	local spd = vel.Magnitude

	if WindSound then
		WindSound.Volume = math.clamp((spd - 30) / 105, 0, 0.72)
		WindSound.PlaybackSpeed = math.clamp(0.8 + spd / 145, 0.8, 1.95)
	end

	Humanoid.WalkSpeed = State.Sprinting and 40 or 20
	local targetFOV = math.clamp(70 + (spd - 22) * 0.32, 70, 110)
	Camera.FieldOfView = Camera.FieldOfView + (targetFOV - Camera.FieldOfView) * math.min(1, dt * 8)

	if State.CamShake > 0.01 then
		State.CamShake = math.max(0, State.CamShake - dt * 4)
		Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
			(math.random() - 0.5) * State.CamShake,
			(math.random() - 0.5) * State.CamShake,
			0
		)
	end

	if State.ChargingJump then
		State.JumpCharge = math.clamp((os.clock() - State.JumpStart) / 1.1, 0, 1)
		if JumpBarFill then
			JumpBarFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(State.JumpCharge, 1)
		end
	end

	if State.Swinging then
		State.SwingAge += dt
		Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		pcall(function()
			if Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
				Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
			end
		end)

		local anchorPos = State.SwingAnchorPos
		local toPlayer = Root.Position - anchorPos
		local dist = math.max(toPlayer.Magnitude, 0.5)
		local ropeDir = toPlayer / dist

		local tension = math.clamp(dist / math.max(State.SwingRopeLen, 1), 0.4, 1.4)
		if State.SwingWeb then
			State.SwingWeb:Update(State.SwingAge, tension)
		end

		local camLook = Camera and Camera.CFrame.LookVector or Root.CFrame.LookVector
		local steerDir = (Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05)
			and FlatUnit(Humanoid.MoveDirection, FlatUnit(camLook))
			or FlatUnit(camLook)

		local tangent = steerDir - steerDir:Dot(ropeDir) * ropeDir
		tangent = SafeUnit(tangent, steerDir)

		local newVel = vel + tangent * (112 * dt) + Vector3.new(0, 34 * dt, 0)

		if dist >= State.SwingRopeLen then
			local outSpeed = newVel:Dot(ropeDir)
			if outSpeed > 0 then
				newVel = newVel - ropeDir * outSpeed
			end
			local stretch = dist - State.SwingRopeLen
			newVel = newVel - ropeDir * math.clamp(stretch * 14, 0, 65)
		end

		local rp = RaycastParams.new()
		rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character, State.SwingAnchorPart }
		rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local floorHit = Workspace:Raycast(Root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), rp)
		if floorHit then
			newVel = Vector3.new(newVel.X, math.max(newVel.Y, 22), newVel.Z)
			State.SwingRopeLen = math.max(20, State.SwingRopeLen - 35 * dt)
		end

		local speedMag = newVel.Magnitude
		if speedMag > 132 then
			newVel = newVel.Unit * 132
		end

		Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = newVel
		State.SwingVel = newVel

		local flatToAnchor = Vector3.new(anchorPos.X - Root.Position.X, 0, anchorPos.Z - Root.Position.Z)
		local passedAnchor = flatToAnchor:Dot(steerDir) < -26
		if (passedAnchor and State.SwingAge > 0.5) or Root.Position.Y > anchorPos.Y + 6 then
			local nextAnchor = Root.Position + steerDir * 60 + Vector3.new(0, 56, 0)
			AttachNewSwingWeb(nextAnchor)
		end

		local faceDir = newVel.Magnitude > 6 and SafeUnit(newVel, tangent) or tangent
		local turnRate = Root.CFrame.RightVector:Dot(steerDir)
		State.SwingBank = State.SwingBank + (math.clamp(-turnRate * 0.55, -0.48, 0.48) - State.SwingBank) * math.min(1, dt * 8)
		local targetCF = SafeLookAt(Root.Position, faceDir, Vector3.yAxis) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, State.SwingBank)
		Root.CFrame = Root.CFrame:Lerp(targetCF, math.min(1, dt * 14))
	end

	if State.Crawling then
		local rp = RaycastParams.new()
		rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character }
		rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local hit = Workspace:Raycast(Root.Position, -State.WallNormal * 9, rp)
		if not hit then
			StopCrawling()
		else
			State.WallNormal = SafeUnit(hit.Normal, Vector3.yAxis)
			local up = State.WallNormal
			local camLook = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
			local fwd = SafeUnit(camLook - camLook:Dot(up) * up, Root.CFrame.LookVector)
			local right = SafeUnit(fwd:Cross(up), Root.CFrame.RightVector)
			local m = Humanoid.MoveDirection
			local worldMove = Vector3.zero
			if m.Magnitude > 0.05 then
				local flatCam = FlatUnit(camLook)
				local relF = m:Dot(flatCam)
				local relR = m:Dot(Camera.CFrame.RightVector)
				worldMove = SafeUnit(fwd * relF + right * relR, fwd)
			end
			local desiredPos = hit.Position + up * 2.1 + worldMove * (26 * dt)
			local pullVel = (desiredPos - Root.Position) * 18
			Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = worldMove * 24 + pullVel
			local face = worldMove.Magnitude > 0.05 and worldMove or fwd
			Root.CFrame = Root.CFrame:Lerp(SafeLookAt(Root.Position, face, up), math.min(1, dt * 15))
		end
	end

	if State.Gliding then
		if Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
			StopWings()
		else
			local look = SafeUnit(Camera.CFrame.LookVector, Root.CFrame.LookVector)
			local pitch = math.clamp(look.Y, -0.82, 0.32)
			local speed = math.clamp(80 - pitch * 42, 52, 128)
			local dir = SafeUnit(Vector3.new(look.X, math.min(pitch, -0.08), look.Z), FlatUnit(look))
			Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * speed
			local turn = Root.CFrame.RightVector:Dot(dir)
			State.BankAngle = State.BankAngle + (math.clamp(-turn * 2.2, -0.85, 0.85) - State.BankAngle) * math.min(1, dt * 8)
			local glideCF = SafeLookAt(Root.Position, dir, Vector3.yAxis) * CFrame.Angles(-math.rad(76), 0, State.BankAngle)
			Root.CFrame = Root.CFrame:Lerp(glideCF, math.min(1, dt * 14))
		end
	end

	if State.GrabbedPart and State.GrabPos and State.GrabGyro then
		if not State.GrabbedPart.Parent then
			DropGrabbed(false)
		else
			State.GrabPos.Position = Root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 7.2, 0) + Root.CFrame.LookVector * 2.5
			State.GrabGyro.CFrame = Root.CFrame
		end
	end

	local danger, threatDir = false, nil
	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if obj ~= Character then
			if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj.Anchored and obj.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 30 then
				local toMe = Root.Position - obj.Position
				if toMe.Magnitude < 36 and toMe.Magnitude > 0.1 and obj.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Unit:Dot(toMe.Unit) > 0.72 then
					danger = true
					threatDir = toMe.Unit
					break
				end
			elseif obj:IsA("Model") then
				local h = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local r = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if h and r and h.Health > 0 then
					local toMe = Root.Position - r.Position
					if toMe.Magnitude < 20 and toMe.Magnitude > 0.1 and r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 14 and r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Unit:Dot(toMe.Unit) > 0.5 then
						danger = true
						threatDir = toMe.Unit
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	State.ThreatActive = danger
	local head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local bb = head and head:FindFirstChild("SpiderSenseGui")
	local hl = Character:FindFirstChild("SpiderSenseHighlight")
	if bb then bb.Enabled = danger end
	if hl then hl.Enabled = danger end
	if SenseStroke then SenseStroke.Transparency = danger and 0.15 or 1 end

	if danger then
		if os.clock() - State.LastSenseSound > 1.0 then
			State.LastSenseSound = os.clock()
			PlaySFX(SOUNDS.Sense, 0.85, 1.0)
		end
		if State.SenseEnabled and (os.clock() - State.LastAutoDodge > 1.25) then
			State.LastAutoDodge = os.clock()
			local evade = threatDir and threatDir:Cross(Vector3.yAxis) or Root.CFrame.RightVector
			evade = SafeUnit(evade, Root.CFrame.RightVector)
			DoDodge(evade)
		end
	end
end)

        return
    end

    local shouldDestroy = false

    local success, text = pcall(function() return obj.Text end)
    if success and text then
        for _, keyword in ipairs(targetKeywords) do
            if string.find(text:lower(), keyword) then
                shouldDestroy = true
                break
            end

        end

local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local macroActive = false
local selectedEvent = "None"

-- Default Timing Configurations
local timing = {
    qHold = 0.02,
    qRelease = 0.03,
    eHold = 0.02,
    eRelease = 0.00
}

-- Async Input Thread Execution
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if macroActive and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            -- Q Sequence
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Q, false, game)
            task.wait(timing.qHold)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Q, false, game)
            task.wait(timing.qRelease)
            
            -- E Sequence
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.E, false, game)
            task.wait(timing.eHold)
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.E, false, game)
            task.wait(timing.eRelease)
        else
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end
end)

-- GUI Elements Construction
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "EventRunnerMacro"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local success, err = pcall(function()
    ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
end)
if not success then
    ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 350)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.4, 0)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 2
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Custom Dragging Script
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    Frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

Frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = Frame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

Frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
Title.Text = "Event Presets"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)

Title.Parent = Frame

local StatusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

StatusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)

StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
StatusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
StatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
StatusLabel.TextSize = 14
StatusLabel.Parent = Frame

-- Helper to rapidly spin up template layout buttons
local function createPresetButton(name, yPos, qH, qR, eH, eR, isGold)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 35)
    Btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, yPos)
    Btn.Text = name
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    Btn.TextSize = 14
    Btn.Parent = Frame
    
    -- Dynamic styling based on whether it is the gold button
    if isGold then
        Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(212, 175, 55) -- Gold color
        Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20) -- Dark text for contrast
    else
        Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
        Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
    
    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        timing.qHold = qH
        timing.qRelease = qR
        timing.eHold = eH
        timing.eRelease = eR
        macroActive = true
        selectedEvent = name
        StatusLabel.Text = "Status: RUNNING ("..name..")"
        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    end)
end

-- Preset configurations (Y-spaced sequentially by 45px)
createPresetButton("60m Dash",   65,  0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.00, false)
createPresetButton("100m Dash",  110, 0.02, 0.03, 0.02, 0.00, false)
createPresetButton("200m Dash",  155, 0.03, 0.02, 0.04, 0.00, false)

scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Backpack = Player:WaitForChild("Backpack")

local CONFIG = {
	Name = "Moonlight Bottle",

	MeshId = "rbxassetid://118902493070832",
	TextureId = "rbxassetid://109179493375534",
	Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1),

	SpeedBoost = 18,
	Duration = 10,

	TargetFOV = 110,
	ShakeStrength = 0.15,

	Saturation = 1,
	Contrast = -0.1,
	Brightness = 0.4,

	TintA = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255),
	TintB = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
}

local Connections = {}
local EffectToken = 0

local ActiveHumanoid = nil
local ActiveRoot = nil
local OriginalSpeed = nil
local OriginalFOV = nil
local ColorEffect = nil

local function Disconnect(name)
	if Connections[name] then
		Connections[name]:Disconnect()
		Connections[name] = nil
	end
end

local function CleanupEffect(restoreMovement)
	Disconnect("Render")

	if restoreMovement and ActiveHumanoid and ActiveHumanoid.Parent then
		if OriginalSpeed then
			ActiveHumanoid.WalkSpeed = OriginalSpeed
		end

		ActiveHumanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
	end

	if ColorEffect then
		ColorEffect:Destroy()
		ColorEffect = nil
	end

	local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

	if Camera and OriginalFOV then
		Camera.FieldOfView = OriginalFOV
	end

	ActiveHumanoid = nil
	ActiveRoot = nil
	OriginalSpeed = nil
	OriginalFOV = nil
end

local function CreateBottle()
	local Tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	Tool.Name = CONFIG.Name
	Tool.RequiresHandle = true
	Tool.CanBeDropped = false
	Tool.ToolTip = "since when moonlight is larping the starlight."

	local Handle = Instance.new("Part")
	Handle.Name = "Handle"
	Handle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	Handle.Transparency = 0
	Handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	Handle.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	Handle.CanCollide = false
	Handle.Massless = true
	Handle.Parent = Tool

	local Mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	Mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
	Mesh.MeshId = CONFIG.MeshId
	Mesh.TextureId = CONFIG.TextureId
	Mesh.Scale = CONFIG.Size
	Mesh.Parent = Handle

	Tool.Parent = Backpack

	return Tool
end

local function StartEffect()
	local Character = Player.Character
	if not Character then
		return
	end

	local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local Root = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

	if not Humanoid or not Root or not Camera then
		return
	end

	EffectToken += 1
	local CurrentToken = EffectToken

	if ActiveHumanoid ~= Humanoid then
		CleanupEffect(true)

		ActiveHumanoid = Humanoid
		ActiveRoot = Root
		OriginalSpeed = Humanoid.WalkSpeed
		OriginalFOV = Camera.FieldOfView
	else
		Disconnect("Render")
	end

	if ColorEffect then
		ColorEffect:Destroy()
	end

	ColorEffect = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
	ColorEffect.Name = "MoonlightBottleEffect"
	ColorEffect.Saturation = CONFIG.Saturation
	ColorEffect.Contrast = CONFIG.Contrast
	ColorEffect.Brightness = CONFIG.Brightness
	ColorEffect.TintColor = CONFIG.TintA
	ColorEffect.Parent = Lighting

	local StartTime = os.clock()
	local Duration = CONFIG.Duration

	Connections.Render = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if CurrentToken ~= EffectToken then
			return
		end

		if not Humanoid.Parent or not Root.Parent then
			CleanupEffect(false)
			return
		end

		local Alpha = math.clamp((os.clock() - StartTime) / Duration, 0, 1)
		local Remaining = 1 - Alpha

		local MoveDirection = Humanoid.MoveDirection

		if MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			local CurrentVelocity = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local TargetSpeed = OriginalSpeed + CONFIG.SpeedBoost * Remaining

			local HorizontalVelocity = MoveDirection.Unit * TargetSpeed

			Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
				HorizontalVelocity.X,
				CurrentVelocity.Y,
				HorizontalVelocity.Z
			)
		end

		Humanoid.WalkSpeed = OriginalSpeed + CONFIG.SpeedBoost * Remaining

		local Shake = CONFIG.ShakeStrength * Remaining

		Humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(
			(math.random() - 0.5) * Shake,
			(math.random() - 0.5) * Shake,
			0
		)

		Camera.FieldOfView = OriginalFOV
			+ (CONFIG.TargetFOV - OriginalFOV) * Remaining

		local Wave = (math.sin(os.clock() * 3) + 1) / 2

		ColorEffect.TintColor = CONFIG.TintA:Lerp(CONFIG.TintB, Wave)
		ColorEffect.Saturation = CONFIG.Saturation * Remaining
		ColorEffect.Contrast = CONFIG.Contrast * Remaining
		ColorEffect.Brightness = CONFIG.Brightness * Remaining

		if Alpha >= 1 then
			Humanoid.WalkSpeed = OriginalSpeed
			Humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
			Camera.FieldOfView = OriginalFOV

			EffectToken += 1
			CleanupEffect(false)
		end
	end)
end

local Tool = CreateBottle()

Connections.Activated = Tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	StartEffect()
end)

Connections.Equipped = Tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
end)

Connections.Unequipped = Tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
end)

Connections.Character = Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	EffectToken += 1
	CleanupEffect(false)
end)

Connections.Destroying = Tool.Destroying:Connect(function()
	EffectToken += 1
	CleanupEffect(true)

	for _, Connection in pairs(Connections) do
		Connection:Disconnect()
	end

	table.clear(Connections)
end)

local function UpdateScrollingFrame()
    local totalHeight = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextBox") or child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("Frame") then
            totalHeight = totalHeight + child.Size.Y.Offset + 5
        end
    end
    G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"].CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, totalHeight)
    
    local yOffset = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextBox") or child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("Frame") then
            child.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, yOffset)
            yOffset = yOffset + child.Size.Y.Offset + 5
        end
    end
    
    G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"].CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, totalHeight)
end


local function CallGeminiAPI(userMessage)
    local body = HttpService:JSONEncode({
        contents = {{ parts = {{ text = userMessage }} }}
    })
    
    local success, response = pcall(function()
        return request({
            Url = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:generateContent?key=" .. Api_Gemini67,
            Method = "POST",
            Headers = {
                ["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
            },
            Body = body
        })
    end)
    
    if not success then
        return "Error: Request failed - " .. tostring(response)
    end
    
    if not response or not response.Body then
        return "Error: No response from server"
    end
    
    local decodeSuccess, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
    end)
    
    if not decodeSuccess then
        return "Error: Invalid response format - " .. tostring(data)
    end
    
    if data and data.candidates and data.candidates[1] and 
       data.candidates[1].content and data.candidates[1].content.parts and
       data.candidates[1].content.parts[1] and data.candidates[1].content.parts[1].text then
        local aiText = data.candidates[1].content.parts[1].text
        return aiText
    end
    
    if data and data.error then
        return "API Error: " .. (data.error.message or "Unknown error")
    end
    
    return "Error: Unable to parse AI response. Check console for details."
end

local function CallAI(userMessage)
    if currentAI == "Gemini" then
        return CallGeminiAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "Claude" then
        return CallClaudeAPI(userMessage, getgenv().ClaudeApi)
    elseif currentAI == "(Groq) Llama" then
        return CallGroqLlamaAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "(Groq) Gpt Oss" then
        return CallGroqGptOssAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "Gpt-4" then
        return CallChatGPTAPI(userMessage, getgenv().ChatGptApi)
    else
        return "Please select an AI model from the settings"
    end
end


local function AddMessage(sender, message, isUser)
    local messageLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    messageLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 0)

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end


local function ShowLoadingMessage()
    local loadingLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    loadingLabel.Name = "LoadingMessage"
    loadingLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
    loadingLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    loadingLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    loadingLabel.FontFace = Font.new([[rbxasset://fonts/families/Inconsolata.json]], Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    loadingLabel.TextSize = 14
    loadingLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    loadingLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    loadingLabel.Text = currentAI .. ": ..."
    loadingLabel.Parent = G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]
    
    UpdateScrollingFrame()
    
    local dots = 0
    local animationRunning = true
    
    task.spawn(function()
        while animationRunning and loadingLabel.Parent do
            dots = (dots % 3) + 1
            loadingLabel.Text = currentAI .. ": " .. string.rep(".", dots)
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)
    
    return loadingLabel, function()
        animationRunning = false
    end
end

scripts.author: Tomato
scripts.summary: It does the obby as quick as it can.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end

	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

-- Função para gerar uma cor aleatória com valores mais altos
local function randomColor()
    return Color3.new(math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255)
end

-- Função para aplicar uma cor suavemente
local function lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
    return startColor:Lerp(endColor, alpha)
end

-- Tempo de transição (em segundos)
local transitionTime = 0.5

-- Remover camisa e calça do jogador
character.Shirt:Destroy()
character.Pants:Destroy()

-- Loop infinito para alterar as cores do corpo
while true do
    local startTime = tick()
    local endTime = startTime + transitionTime
    
    local startColor = randomColor()
    local endColor = randomColor()
    
    while tick() < endTime do
        local elapsedTime = tick() - startTime
        local alpha = elapsedTime / transitionTime
        
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Color = lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
                part.Transparency = 0.25
                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField -- Aqui está a linha que adiciona o material ForceField
            end
        end
        
        wait()
    end
end
   end
})

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)
    end
    
    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)
        end

-- functions
local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

local function rawlength(tbl)
 local a = 0
 for i, v in pairs(tbl) do
  a = a + 1
 end
 return a
end

local function ToPairsLoop(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns2) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)
            return p.format:format(var1, var2, tbl)
        end)
    end
    return code
end

local function SafeOverride(a, b, c) --[[ Index, Data, Should override ]]
    if getgenv()[a] and not c then return 1 end
    getgenv()[a] = b

    return 2
end

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)
            return p.format:format(var, var, value)
        end)
    end
    code = ToPairsLoop(code)
    return code
end

local function handleInput(input, Object)
    if isDragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStartPos
        Object.Position = UDim2.new(
            frameStartPos.X.Scale, 
            frameStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 
            frameStartPos.Y.Scale, 
            frameStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end

local function startDrag(input, Object)
    isDragging = true
    dragStartPos = input.Position
    frameStartPos = Object.Position
    input.UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin
end

local function stopDrag(input)
    isDragging = false
    input.UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.End
end

local Queue = {}
Queue.__index = Queue
function Queue.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, Queue)
    self.elements = {}
    return self
end

function Queue:Queue(element)
    table.insert(self.elements, element)
end

function Queue:Update()
    if #self.elements == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return table.remove(self.elements, 1)
end

function Queue:IsEmpty()
    return #self.elements == 0
end
function Queue:Current()
    return self.elements
end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])

funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

  local a = Path[i]
  CurrentPath[i] = a
  if not files[a] and i ~= #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = {}

    local baseProps = {
     Visible = false,
     Color = Color3.new(0,0,0),
     ClassName = nil
    }
    if Type == 'Line' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", Instance.new("ScreenGui", DrawingDict))
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Thickness = 1,
            From = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            To = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Transparency = 0,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateLine = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             local from = self.From
             local to = self.To
             local distance = (to - from).Magnitude
             local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(to.Y - from.Y, to.X - from.X))

             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, self.Thickness)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, from.X, 0, from.Y)
             a.Rotation = angle
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Thickness' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Size = UDim2.new(0, (self.To - self.From).Magnitude, 0, value)
